judged_text: The save success handler re-derives the category from local state (`Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId)`) instead of using the serialized host returned by the server, which is the component that applies the blank-to-uncategorized fallback. When an admin clears the category chooser and saves, the server stores `uncategorized_category_id` but the row renders a blank category badge (findById(null) is undefined) until the next full page reload, and the discarded response already contained the correct value.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` success handler sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and then, after `host.save(props)`, forces `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` (i.e., it uses the pre-save UI state). On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly applies a blank-to-uncategorized fallback: `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`. If the chooser yields `null`/blank, the server will persist uncategorized and return the updated `category_id` in `EmbeddableHostSerializer`, but the client will still set `category` to `findById(null)` (undefined), so the row will render an empty `{{category-badge host.category}}` until reloaded/rehydrated. The finding matches this diff-grounded behavior.
